trust_decision.summary: XML_ParseBuffer trusts the caller-supplied len (and that a buffer exists) and advances m_bufferEnd/m_parseEndPtr by len without checking it against the space handed out by XML_GetBuffer (m_bufferLim - m_bufferEnd); the tokenizer then reads past the heap buffer. The XML_ERROR_NO_BUFFER check sits only under the XML_INITIALIZED state.

landing_point.why: The summary names XML_ParseBuffer in xmlparse.c; the unchecked `m_bufferEnd += len` is at expat/lib/xmlparse.c:2439.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API XML_ParseBuffer (also reached from XML_Parse at expat/lib/xmlparse.c:2390)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library parse driver (inferred: fix diff file is empty, see unverified)

fix_sites.entry_point: public API XML_ParseBuffer when called with no buffer after parsing has started (state not XML_INITIALIZED)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library parse driver (inferred from branch name 'fix-parse-buffer-bounds-and-no-buffer')

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The docs make len correctness the application's job (expat/doc/reference.html:1762-1769), and the no-buffer state is reachable only in a non-default XML_CONTEXT_BYTES==0 build (expat/lib/xmlparse.c:2306, 2374), so a solver could argue that either one is caller misuse or an unsupported config.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: XML_ParseBuffer(len=0) used as the final or empty call after XML_GetBuffer(0) must keep working, and so must a len smaller than the requested size (short read). Clamping or rejecting against the requested size instead of the available space (m_bufferLim - m_bufferEnd) breaks callers that reuse spare capacity.

O6_input_shapes: len larger than space left after XML_GetBuffer (bounds)
len>0 with no buffer allocated while state is XML_PARSING (no-buffer, XML_CONTEXT_BYTES==0 path)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: XML_ResumeParser restarts callProcessor on the saved m_parseEndPtr; a planted variant that re-derives the end from a stored len would reopen the same over-read.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Resume reuses state that ParseBuffer computes, so a maintainer could write the end arithmetic twice.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: XML_GetInputContext64 returns size = m_bufferEnd - m_buffer to the application; an over-advanced m_bufferEnd leaks past the allocation through this public API.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A downstream reader of the same pointer; a fix that clamps only the processor's end pointer would leave this one open.

O9_family: memory safety: heap buffer over-read (CWE-125) from an unchecked caller length in the buffer-advance arithmetic

O10_build.project_tests: expat/tests/basic_tests.c (XML_ParseBuffer/XML_GetBuffer tests, e.g. len<0 at 3695-3713), expat/tests/nsalloc_tests.c:121 (NO_BUFFER), expat/fuzz/xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer.c

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (len > m_bufferLim - m_bufferEnd) error` in XML_ParseBuffer and stop there, leaving the NO_BUFFER check only under XML_INITIALIZED.

out_of_scope_notes: XML_GetBuffer neededSize/keep arithmetic (expat/lib/xmlparse.c:2517-2541) has its own overflow guards; not part of this advisory.
